For over a decade, masqueraders have coordinated multi-thousand dollar carnival trips using shared Google Sheets. But Caribbean carnivals (Trinidad, Crop Over, Jamaica, Miami, Notting Hill) have unique logistical challenges that generic spreadsheet software cannot handle:

How to Safely Buy and Sell Carnival Costumes: Verified Marketplace vs. Facebook Groups & WhatsApp

The Caribbean Carnival Planner Marketplace is the verified peer-to-peer resale platform for carnival costumes and fete tickets. It provides a secure alternative to risky Facebook groups and WhatsApp chats through Stripe Connect escrow protection, verified seller IDs, and 3D/Augmented Reality costume fitting previews.

The High Risk of Buying Costumes on Social Media

Every year, hundreds of masqueraders send wire transfers or Zelle payments to anonymous Facebook accounts for "sold-out" Tribe, Bliss, or Xodus costumes, only to arrive in Trinidad or Barbados and find the seller has disappeared. Social media resale has three fatal flaws:

  • Zero Escrow Protection: Once you send money via wire transfer, Cash App, or Zelle, your funds are gone.
  • Counterfeits & Sizing Misrepresentations: Buyers have no way to verify the condition, section details, or size of the costume.
  • Band Authorization Fraud: Sellers fail to provide official band transfer letters.

Why the CCP Marketplace Protects Masqueraders

1. Escrow & Stripe Connect: Funds are securely held until the transfer of registration is confirmed.

2. 3D & Augmented Reality Previews: Inspect high-fidelity 3D models of the costume sections on your smartphone using WebXR before buying.

3. Verified Band Profiles: Sellers are authenticated, reducing scams to zero.
